title: Unique Snappy Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A peppery and snappy Peruvian dish featuring seeds and a deglaze fond, perfect for midnight cravings, this low glycemic friendly lomo saltado is a must try. It combines the tenderness of beef with the crunch of seeds and the savory flavor of Peruvian spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3 minutes, then set aside.
Add the sesame seeds and pumpkin seeds to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and diced onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook until it starts to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the sliced Peruvian aji amarillo pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and lime juice to the skillet, scraping the bottom to deglaze, and cook for 1 minute.
Return the beef strips to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the lomo saltado hot over rice or noodles.
